description: Add fa_missions.learning_objective and backfill it from the authored content (aca-trn-03). A mission advertised XP, estimated minutes and difficulty — three costs — and never stated what the learner would be able to do afterwards, which is the auditable unit for training used in a compliance context. Written in Python rather than SQL because the column has to be added idempotently on both engines (ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is PostgreSQL-only and a bare ADD COLUMN raises on the second SQLite run) and because the backfill values come from content_loader.extract_learning_objective rather than being duplicated into the migration as literals. Missions whose content states no objective are left NULL on purpose: an absent objective is a visible content gap, an invented one is an invisible false record
